input: // anyone in the editors group can view and edit documents in their workspace
when { resource.workspace == principal.workspace && resource has owner };
// nobody can delete an archived document unless they own it and it was archived over 30 days ago
when { resource.archived } unless { resource.owner == principal && context.daysSinceArchived > 30 };

lineWidth.description: The width of a line the formatter will try to stay under. Note that this limit will be exceeded in some cases.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces for an indent.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
